title: Necrosis Detection in Meningioma Images
summary: IIIT Bangalore presents a computational-pathology pipeline for necrosis detection, with clinical decision support as its intended application.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Researchers describe a machine-learning pipeline that detects necrosis in meningioma images under limited-data conditions. It runs on university servers and is presented as promising computational-neuropathology research. The source does not give a deployment improvement, comparative diagnostic effect, or patient outcome.
purpose: Assist pathological identification of necrotic tissue.

ratings.reason: University-hosted necrosis detection is a limited-data computational-pathology experiment, not a documented clinical workflow improvement.
No patient diagnosis or treatment outcome is documented.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 11: Necrosis Detection in Meningioma Images

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.
